deal.summary: Facilio was positioned as a Connected CaFM platform for Abdul Latif Jameel Properties, focused on property and FM operations for three residential buildings and about 500 tenants. The discussion progressed through an initial requirements conversation with Kamal Ahmed Aljohani and then a detailed product demo on 24 Apr 2025 for Marwah and the wider team, covering tenant management, maintenance workflows, vendor engagement, dashboards, exports, and integrations. The use case was centered on ALJ’s
deal.lastOut: Last contact date: 24 Apr 2025 Channel: Both Who reached out from Facilio: Syed Omer Hussaini and Sudheera Polaggari What was discussed: On the call, Facilio walked Marwah through the Connected CaFM demo, including tenant portal, vendor portal, maintenance management, workflow configurability, exports to Excel, dashboards, and integration with Yardi. At the end of the meeting, Marwah asked Facilio to send “everything you sent to Kamal before, like this presentation” and said she would discuss it

deal.evalFor: Modules and features discussed: - Connected CaFM / maintenance management - Tenant management and tenant portal - Vendor management and vendor portal - Service requests and work orders - Preventive/planned maintenance - Workflow/state flow builder - Dashboards and analytics - Export to Excel/CSV/PDF - Quote/invoice capability - Mobile apps for FM, vendor, and tenant users - Open API / integration framework - Custom modules / connected apps for additional use cases Use cases they cared most about
deal.reEngage: Opening line: In our last demo, you mentioned Kamal had deeper property background and that you wanted to review the materials with him before deciding on another session—would it help if we now run a focused walkthrough just on the Yardi integration points and tenant/vendor workflows your team prioritized?
deal.nextStep: Re-discovery call — because the only solid next step after the demo was for Marwah to review the material internally with Kamal and for ALJ to complete the questionnaire for a techno-commercial proposal, so the best path is to reassemble the business and digital stakeholders, confirm whether the original requirements still stand, and restart momentum from that point.
